newsitem.title: USA: Stimsonite posts Q4 loss after charge.
newsitem.headline: Stimsonite posts Q4 loss after charge.

text.p: Stimsonite Corp said Tuesday a charge tied to a previously announced restructuring contributed to a widening of its net loss in the fourth quarter ended December 31.
The company reported a loss of $4.4 million in the period, or $0.49 a share, compared to a loss of $237,000, or $0.03, one year ago. Sales fell to $16.2 million, from $17.8 million in 1995.
Stimsonite said the one-time restructuring charge was $4 million before taxes, and a charge to cover provisions for product obsolescence and other reserves totaled $1.0 million.
The company also reported an operating loss of $2.6 million in the period, versus income of $700,000 last year.
Its shares closed unchanged Tuesday at 6-1/4.
